commands.blocker_closure_criterion: The UNIT (seconds) is established, but the exact reference/encoding is not: is the written UINT32 a Unix epoch timestamp, seconds since an unstated device-specific epoch, or a relative/delta value? The official PDF states only 'UINT32, 4 bytes, W, 对时/Timecalibration, seconds' with no worked example or epoch definition. Writing an assumed epoch (e.g. guessing Unix time) to a real BMS RTC without source confirmation is exactly the fabricated-payload-value case this Stage forbids, even though the unit/scale is more precisely known here than for the other 7 commands. Resolved by an official clarification of the epoch/reference point, or a controlled protocol-capture experiment comparing a written value against the BMS's own subsequently-read wall-clock behavior.
